create_hyv3_mtp_model: create an HY V3 MTP inference model from a VllmConfig for multi-token prediction
build_mtp_layer: build an HYV3MultiTokenPredictorLayer with config, prefix, and quantization settings
run_mtp_forward: run the HYV3MTP forward pass with input_ids, positions, and hidden_states
load_mtp_weights: load HuggingFace checkpoint weights into the HYV3MTP model with weight mapping
compute_mtp_logits: compute logits from hidden_states using the MTP model's shared head and logits processor
